title: Assert the whole response shape
description: Only checks the status code of a profile response.
issue_title: Test misses the response body contract
issue_description: A passing status code does not prove the endpoint returned the expected fields or values.
issue_suggestion: Assert the JSON structure or key output fields in addition to the status code.

title: Do not mock the function under test
description: Patches the same helper the test is supposed to verify.
issue_title: The implementation under test is mocked away
issue_description: Mocking the function being validated makes the test tautological and unable to catch regressions.
issue_suggestion: Mock dependencies around the function under test, not the function itself.

title: Avoid brittle timestamp assertions
description: Asserts an exact timestamp string produced during the test.
issue_title: Test depends on an exact runtime timestamp
issue_description: Clock-based values vary by execution time and make the test flaky.
issue_suggestion: Freeze time or assert a more stable invariant about the timestamp.

title: Await async work in tests
description: Calls an async function in a test without awaiting it.
code:
async def test_send_email():
    result = send_email('a@example.com')
    assert result['ok'] is True
issue_title: Coroutine result is never awaited
issue_description: The test inspects a coroutine object instead of running the async code.
issue_suggestion: Await the async function before asserting on its result.

title: Reset shared mutable fixtures
description: Appends into a module-level list reused across tests.
code:
EVENTS = []

def test_add_event():
    EVENTS.append('signup')
    assert len(EVENTS) == 1
issue_title: Test shares mutable state across runs
issue_description: Global mutable state can leak between tests and cause order-dependent failures.
issue_suggestion: Create fresh state per test or clear the shared fixture before each run.

title: Prefer semantic assertions over raw HTML substrings
description: Checks page content using a fragile HTML substring.
issue_title: Assertion is tightly coupled to markup formatting
issue_description: Minor template formatting changes can break the test without changing user-visible behavior.
issue_suggestion: Assert on parsed content or a semantically meaningful text node.

title: Exercise the negative path
description: Only tests the successful login flow.
issue_title: Failure behavior is untested
issue_description: Missing negative-path coverage leaves authentication error handling unverified.
issue_suggestion: Add a test for invalid credentials or locked accounts.

title: Use deterministic factory data
description: Generates random email addresses inside the assertion.
issue_title: Fixture data is uncontrolled
issue_description: Randomized fixture values can hide intent and make failures harder to reproduce.
issue_suggestion: Pass explicit values for fields that matter to the assertion.

title: Do not swallow assertion failures in helpers
description: Catches every exception inside a custom test helper.
issue_title: Assertion failures are hidden
issue_description: Swallowing failures turns broken expectations into false negatives instead of visible test failures.
issue_suggestion: Let assertion errors propagate or raise a clearer failure message.

title: Wait for eventual consistency in integration tests
description: Asserts immediately after enqueuing background work.
issue_title: Test ignores asynchronous processing delay
issue_description: Background jobs may not have completed by the time the assertion runs.
issue_suggestion: Poll or wait for the async side effect before asserting.

title: Assert side effects, not only return values
description: Mocks email delivery but never checks it was called.
issue_title: The intended side effect is never asserted
issue_description: The test passes even if the reset email was never sent.
issue_suggestion: Assert the mailer interaction or emitted event explicitly.

title: Use transaction rollback between database tests
description: Creates rows in the real test database without cleanup.
issue_title: Database state persists across tests
issue_description: Leaked rows can make later tests fail depending on execution order.
issue_suggestion: Wrap each test in a rollback transaction or truncate tables between tests.

title: Validate exception messages carefully
description: Only asserts that some exception is raised.
issue_title: Test misses the specific validation contract
issue_description: If the wrong ValueError path is raised, the test still passes.
issue_suggestion: Assert the exception message or a more specific error type when it matters.
issue_code: with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='amount must be numeric'):

title: Avoid sleep-based retries in tests
description: Uses a fixed sleep before checking a queue consumer.
code:
def test_job_processed(client):
    client.post('/jobs')
    time.sleep(2)
    assert worker.processed_count() == 1
issue_title: Fixed sleep makes the test slow and flaky
issue_description: The job may finish sooner or later than the hard-coded delay.
issue_suggestion: Wait on a condition or signal instead of sleeping blindly.

title: Use parameterized tests for repeated cases
description: Repeats nearly identical assertions across input pairs.
issue_title: The test cases are repetitive and harder to extend
issue_description: Duplicated test bodies make it easier to miss cases and harder to maintain the suite.
issue_suggestion: Use parameterization for the varying inputs and expectations.

title: Do not hit external APIs in unit tests
description: Calls a production weather API directly from a test.
issue_title: Unit test depends on an external network call
issue_description: External services make tests slow, flaky, and sensitive to credentials or rate limits.
issue_suggestion: Stub the HTTP client or record a fixture response instead of calling the live API.

title: Check observable behavior after refetch
description: Only asserts that a refetch callback was invoked.
issue_title: User-visible state is not verified
issue_description: The test proves the callback ran but not that the UI updated with the reloaded data.
issue_suggestion: Assert the rendered state after the refetch completes.

title: Control timeouts in debounce tests
description: Expects a debounced search call immediately after typing.
issue_title: Debounced behavior is asserted too early
issue_description: The test ignores the delay built into the debounced callback.
issue_suggestion: Use fake timers or wait for the debounce window to elapse.

title: Avoid over-specified mock expectations
description: Asserts every header on an outbound HTTP mock.
issue_title: The test is fragile to irrelevant transport details
issue_description: Minor non-functional header changes can break the test while behavior remains correct.
issue_suggestion: Assert only the critical contract fields that matter to the scenario.

title: Verify ordering when it matters
description: Only checks that two audit events were emitted.
issue_title: Event ordering is not asserted
issue_description: For audit or workflow logic, sequence can be part of the contract and regressions may go unnoticed.
issue_suggestion: Assert the expected event order explicitly.

title: Use isolated temp directories in filesystem tests
description: Writes fixture output into a hard-coded local folder.
issue_title: Filesystem path is shared across tests and machines
issue_description: Hard-coded paths can collide across runs and leave stale files behind.
issue_suggestion: Use a per-test temporary directory fixture.
